notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.3.0 bundles Browser CRM V4.0 and makes Supabase the shared CRM source for leads. Existing Desktop SQLite remains a local mirror/cache. On startup and every 15 seconds while active, Desktop-only leads upload to Supabase, cloud-only leads mirror into Desktop, and same-ID changes resolve by updated_at. Existing Desktop UUIDs are reused in Supabase. Browser CRM edits, notes, summaries, pipeline changes, follow-ups, call outcomes and new leads write through to Supabase; hosted/standalone Browser CRM can use the same cloud leads after GitHub sign-in. Rich FirstSeen metadata is stored under website_audit.firstseen so the current Supabase schema can be used without a destructive migration. Existing Twilio calling, messaging, Finder, call scripts, summaries, SQLite data and updater behaviour are preserved.
